pattern: join on two keys and derive one measure from each table
question: district wise 2023: ANC completed over registered and employed over enrolled from both tables
gold_sql: SELECT a.district, ROUND(100.0 * a.anc4_completed / a.pregnancies_registered, 1) AS anc_percent, ROUND(100.0 * l.employed_at_6_months / l.women_enrolled, 1) AS employment_percent FROM anc_visits AS a INNER JOIN livelihoods AS l ON a.district = l.district AND a.year = l.year WHERE a.year = 2023 ORDER BY a.district
sql_duckdb: SELECT T1.district, (CAST(T1.anc4_completed AS REAL) / NULLIF(T1.pregnancies_registered, 0)) AS ANC_completion_rate, (CAST(T2.employed_at_6_months AS REAL) / NULLIF(T2.women_enrolled, 0)) AS employment_rate FROM anc_visits AS T1 INNER JOIN livelihoods AS T2 ON T1.district = T2.district AND T1.year = T2.year WHERE T1.year = 2023
